name: Instant Race
author: Moorzii
description: Instant Race is back: like F1 2017's Instant Race, jump straight onto the grid. Pick (or randomise) an era, car, track, weather, time of day and race length from your installed seasons and tracks. Includes a Surprise mode. Press F7 on the main menu.

options.label: Instant Race Menu Key
options.description: Keyboard key used on the main menu to open or close Instant Race.

options.label: Show Instant Race Button
options.description: Show the Instant Race button in the top right of the main menu.
